data.exact_reserve_text: During 2015 the Syndicate released GBP 95.7m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2014: GBP 77.4m), arising predominantly from the Energy, Casualty and Treaty Divisions (2014: primarily from the Marine, Property and Treaty Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on attritional losses during 2015.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross release of technical claims reserves of GBP 95.7m in 2015, primarily driven by favourable claims development on attritional losses. The release arose predominantly in the Energy, Casualty and Treaty divisions. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 1,579.2m, so the release represents approximately a 6.06% reduction versus opening reserves. Several named 2015 loss events (PEMEX platform explosion, damage to Chevron's 'Bigfoot' platform, AMOS-5 satellite loss, and several aviation losses) are discussed in the report but are not quantified against the prior-year releases.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' prior-year column (2014). Prior-year development used the Movement note's explicit gross release amount (GBP 95.7m) which the report states as 'released' (gross). The Movement note gives no per-LOB amounts, so LOB-specific impacts are inferred only from the sentence 'arising predominantly from the Energy, Casualty and Treaty Divisions'. Named events are mentioned in narrative but are not quantified in the prior-year movement note. Claims development triangle was used for supplementary detail; the triangle includes an aggregate '2010 and prior' column which has been excluded per instructions.
